name: Drake, Radiation
body:
RADIATION DRAKE
CR 9

XP 6,400
CE Large dragon
Init +8; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +16

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (–1 size, +4 Dex, +10 natural)
hp 104 (11d12+33)
Fort +12, Ref +11, Will +9
DR 5/magic; Immune paralysis, radiation, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)
Melee bite +17 (2d8+6 plus radiation exposure), tail slap +11 (2d6+3 plus radiation exposure)
Ranged atomic bolt +14 touch (3d8 fire plus radiation exposure, max. range 60 ft.)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks atomic breath (30-ft. cone, 6d8 fire plus radiation exposure, DC 18 half)

STATISTICS

Str 23 (+6); Dex 18 (+4); Con 17 (+3); Int 6 (–2); Wis 14 (+2); Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +11; CMB +18; CMD 32
Feats Flyby Attack, Great Fortitude, Improved initiative, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Fly +16, Intimidate +14, Perception +16, Survival +16
Languages Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Atomic Bolt (Ex)

As a standard action, a radiation drake can fire a bolt of radioactive plasma at a single target within 60 feet, This is a ranged touch attack that deals 3d8 fire damage. Anyone who takes damage from this ability also suffers from the drake’s radiation exposure ability.

Atomic Breath (Ex)

As a standard action, a radiation drake can emit a wide beam of radiation from its mouth in a 30-foot cone. All targets within this area take 6d8 fire damage. A successful Reflex save halves the damage. Anyone who takes damage from this ability also suffers from the drake’s radiation exposure ability. Once a radiation drake uses its atomic breath, it cannot do so again for 1d6 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Radiation Exposure (Ex)

A creature that takes hit point damage from a radiation drake’s attacks is exposed to low radiation (see sidebar). This radiation bypasses any radiation resistance provided by technology (such as the radiation buffer armor modification) or spells (such as planetary adaptation Pots), but not a creature’s innate resistance to poison or radiation effects.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land or underground
Organization solitary, pair, or rad (3–9)
Treasure standard

Radiation drakes are natives of regions plagued by radiation. They can be found in subterranean realms where deposits of radioactive ores are plentiful, as well as in wastelands scarred by the use of atomic weapons or magical sources of radiation.

While radiation drakes are naturally drawn to these areas, it is also believed that the eggs of other drakes can be influenced to become radiation drakes if exposed to radiation while developing.

Radiation drakes are impulsive, selfish, and destructive by nature. As they are able to draw energy from the radiation around them, they do not need to feed as other dragons do, but they still kill for pleasure—often playing with their food, tormenting it, and weakening it with radiation before delivering the killing blow.

Sidebar: Radiation

Radiation is a poison effect whose initial effect causes Con drain and secondary effect causes Str damage. Radiation dangers are organized into four categories: low, medium, high, and severe.

Area of Effect Radiation suffuses a spherical area of effect that can extend into solid objects. The closer one gets to the center of an area of radiation, the stronger the radiation effect becomes. Radiation entries list the maximum level of radiation in an area, as well as the radius out to which this radiation level applies. Each increment up to an equal length beyond that radius degrades the radiation strength by one level. For example, a spherical area of high radiation with a radius of 20 feet creates a zone of medium radiation 21 feet to 40 feet from the center in all directions, and a similar zone of low radiation from 41 to 60 feet.

Initial Effect Radiation initially deals Constitution drain unless the affected character succeeds at a Fortitude save. A new saving throw must be attempted to resist radiation’s initial damage each round a victim remains exposed to it.

Secondary Effect Secondary effects from radiation deal Strength damage at a much slower rate than most poisons. This secondary effect ends only after a character succeeds at two consecutive Fortitude saving throws to resist secondary radiation damage. If a character has Strength damage equal to his current Strength score, further damage dealt by a secondary effect is instead Constitution damage.

Removing Radiation Effects All radiation damage is a poison effect, and as such it can be removed with any effect that neutralizes poison. Ability damage and drain caused by radiation damage can be healed normally.
